properties.name: Sample_Widgets
properties.description: A technical example of the field widgets: an international phone number stored in E.164, a date and time picker, a country list, an address field that can suggest addresses, and a drop zone for files.

properties.label: Phone
properties.hint: Pick a country, then type the number: it is stored as +33612345678.

properties.label: Date and time
properties.hint: From now on, in steps of 15 minutes.
properties.validationMessage: Please choose a date and time.

properties.label: Country of residence
properties.hint: Stored as a two-letter country code, for example FR.

properties.label: Street
properties.hint: Suggestions are off: choose a provider in the field settings to turn them on. Without one, nothing is sent anywhere.

properties.label: Your file
properties.hint: Drop a PDF or an image here, or browse.
